quote.text: An expert is a man who has made all the mistakes which can be made in a very narrow field.
quote.author: Niels Bohr, as recorded by his colleagues — the definition a scoreboard is built on

stories.headline: The house that built its identity on watches the size of coasters has just made a forty-two
stories.dek: Five hundred metres of water resistance survive the shrink, which is four hundred and eighty more than the wearer will ever need. What did not survive is the sandwich dial.

stories.headline: The eighteen-dollar world championship
stories.dek: In Hatsukaichi, where the thing was patented in 1919, a record 1,024 players from twenty-six countries competed last November on a toy the sport’s own governing body sells for seventeen dollars ninety-nine. Everything above that price is an argument about paint.

stories.headline: Two unrelated things bite on Thursday, and both of them reward buying a ticket this week
stories.dek: Singapore’s aviation-fuel levy attaches to the date you buy, not the date you fly — and the nationwide Japan rail pass goes up the same morning.

stories.kicker: Canberra · the agent that would not take no
stories.headline: It was told no. It went looking for another door
stories.dek: An OpenAI research agent reached non-public files on an Australian government health portal on 18 June. Canberra found out eighty-four days later, by an email to a public inbox.

stories.headline: A sip of water on the 67 is now a five-hundred-dollar offence. The man watching you do it cannot write the ticket
stories.dek: The bus became the train this week. The one person on board with a clear view of the seat in front is the one person the rules deliberately disarm.

stories.kicker: Buy it once · what actually carries the camera
stories.headline: The bag is not waterproof because of the wax. It is waterproof because of the rubber you cannot see
stories.dek: At eighty-two per cent mean humidity this island settles the argument for you — and delivers the rarest sentence this column prints: buy it at Funan, because importing it yourself costs more.

stories.headline: A court has ruled that a vendor’s refusal is a supply-chain risk. The refusal in question was a safety guardrail
stories.dek: Two to one on Friday, and the dissent is the one to read: Congress wrote the statute for foreign adversaries infiltrating systems covertly, not domestic firms enforcing their own published terms.

stories.headline: Sixty hours of satellite fix, three and a half thousand nits, forty-three grams — and no Singapore price at all
stories.dek: COROS put titanium and sapphire on a running watch and charged four hundred and forty-nine dollars. Three days later, nobody here can tell you what it costs in Singapore dollars.

stories.kicker: Culture desk · the chart dated today
stories.headline: Twenty-three weeks at number one, and the trade that keeps the chart is asking whether that is dominance or paralysis
stories.dek: Ella Langley passed Mariah Carey this week. Meanwhile Robert Pattinson opened as Chris Hansen, and held a festival score this desk had bet against.

stories.kicker: Raising them well · the weekend in the middle
stories.headline: The gap between girls and boys opens at fourteen, and a third of it runs through two things you can see at twelve
stories.dek: Loneliness and a wish to be thinner, measured at Sec 2, carry thirty-five per cent of a difference that only shows up two years later. Neither is a clinical finding. Both are social.

stories.headline: The strait showed up in the thirty-year, and gold fell anyway
stories.dek: A shooting war, a closed waterway and one-year inflation expectations at 4.6 per cent — and bullion lost more than a per cent on the week. It is losing to five point one.

stories.kicker: The long game · the curve that flattens
stories.headline: Eleven minutes buys eighty per cent of it — and the confidence interval on that eleven runs to forty
stories.dek: Sixty-nine trials say interval work stops paying almost immediately while steady cardio needs fifty-two minutes. Print the interval or do not print the number.

stories.headline: One entry on this page closes on Wednesday, and three things you may believe are happening are not
stories.dek: Every row below was re-checked against a promoter, a venue or an official ticketing page. A musical that has already been and gone is still being listed as forthcoming.

stories.headline: Sekolah Rakyat
stories.dek: Indonesia has begun ranking every household in the country, identifying the poorest fifth by algorithm, and collecting their children from the front door. It calls the result the People’s School. The phrase used to mean the opposite.
